name: Monsoon flash flood – Kerian & Kuala Kangsar
description: Rain over Kerian and Kuala Kangsar builds past 60 mm in 3 hours while Sungai Kurau, Sungai Samagagah and Sungai Perak rise from Normal through Alert and Warning to Danger over about an hour of demo time. Uses real JPS stations and their official thresholds; readings are synthetic.
comment: waterStage: 0 = normal level, 1 = Alert, 2 = Warning, 3 = Danger threshold (fractions interpolate between them). t = demo minutes.
